Thanks again for the call today — quick notes and action items.

Summary: dry-run went as planned. We walked through the 16 priority CAIQ questions and flagged 5 items that require evidence or follow-up (noted below). Aditya demonstrated a sanitized 24h log export and showed where retention policies are enforced. Marissa reviewed SOC2 coverage and vendor attestations.

Action items:
- ADITYA: produce final sanitized logs sample (axiom_sanitized_logs_sample.txt) and README; include hash mapping doc — due 2026-12-13.
- MARISSA: upload redwood_response_matrix.csv with links to certs and SOC2 PDF; include a short paragraph on annual attestation window — due 2026-12-14.
- SOOJIN: provide the redwood CAIQ mapping spreadsheet and a recommended evidence checklist for procurement to mark as "Submitted" — due 2026-12-15.

Follow-ups / open questions:
- Q17 (data residency): Axiomlytics asked whether logs exported via our console can be pinned to a single region post-ingest. We confirmed retention control is regional for pinned exports but operational logs remain multi-region until archived. Aditya to provide the config snippet.
- Q42 (key management): asked for HSM vendor details and rotation cadence; Marissa to provide the vendor summary and rotation policy excerpt.

Attachments referenced: axiom_sanitized_logs_sample.txt (will land in shared Drive), redwood_response_matrix.csv, Axiom_CAIQ_seed.xlsx (from Emily).

Links: HubSpot deal AXM-2026-0914 — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
